sloka: तेनास्त्रेण हतं रक्षः काकुत्स्थेन तदा रणे।सञ्छिन्नहृदयं तत्र पपात च ममार च ।। ६.७९.३८ ।।
transliteration: tenāstreṇa hataṁ rakṣaḥ kākutsthena tadā raṇe।sañchinnahṛdayaṁ tatra papāta ca mamāra ca ।। 6.79.38 ।।

translations.english: Then Rama the beloved of Raghus, laughing at Maka raksha, fixed missile presided by fire god.
